Name: Saints Peter & Paul Greek Orthodox Church
label: CO: Boulder - Sts. Peter and Paul
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῶν Ἁγ. Ἀποστόλων.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: τῶν ἁγίων ἐνδόξων καὶ πανευφήμων Ἀποστόλων καὶ Πρωτοκορυφαίων, Πέτρου καὶ Παύλου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τῶν ἁγίων ἐνδόξων καὶ πανευφήμων Ἀποστόλων καὶ Πρωτοκορυφαίων, Πέτρου καὶ Παύλου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Οἱ τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι, καὶ τῆς οἰκουμένης διδάσκαλοι, τῷ Δεσπότῃ τῶν ὅλων πρεσβεύσατε, εἰρήνην τῇ οἰκουμένῃ δωρήσασθαι, καὶ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῶν ἁγίων ἐνδόξων καὶ πανευφήμων Ἀποστόλων καὶ Πρωτοκορυφαίων, Πέτρου καὶ Παύλου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῶν ἁγίων ἐνδόξων καὶ πανευφήμων Ἀποστόλων καὶ Πρωτοκορυφαίων, Πέτρου καὶ Παύλου,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For the Apostles.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: of the holy, glorious, and all-laudable, paramount Apostles Peter and Paul,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy, glorious, and all-laudable, paramount Apostles Peter and Paul,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Preeminent Apostles and teachers of the universe, intercede with the Master of all, to grant peace to the whole world, and great mercy to our souls.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy, glorious, and all-laudable, paramount Apostles Peter and Paul,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy, glorious, and all-laudable, paramount Apostles Peter and Paul.

Name: Archangel Michael Church
label: CO: Colorado Springs - Archangel Michael
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἀρχαγγέλου Μιχαήλ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Τῶν οὐρανίων στρατιῶν Ἀρχιστράτηγε, δυσωποῦμέν σε ἀεὶ ἡμεῖς οἱ ἀνάξιοι, ἵνα ταῖς σαῖς δεήσεσι τειχίσῃς ἡμᾶς, σκέπῃ τῶν πτερύγων, τῆς ἀΰλου σου δόξης, φρουρῶν ἡμᾶς προσπίπτοντας, ἐκτενῶς καὶ βοῶντας· Ἐκ τῶν κινδύνων λύτρωσαι ἡμᾶς, ὡς ταξιάρχης τῶν ἄνω Δυνάμεων.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἐνδόξου Ἀρχαγγέλου Μιχαήλ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἐνδόξου Ἀρχαγγέλου Μιχαήλ,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For Archangel Michael.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: O Chief Commander of the heavenly armies, * we the unworthy now entreat you in earnest, * to fortify us by your supplications to the Lord, * and shelter us beneath the wings of your spiritual glory, * guarding us who run to you and fervently entreat you: * As the Commander of the hosts on high, * rescue us faithful from dangers of every kind.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy and glorious Archangel Michael,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy and glorious Archangel Michael.

Name: Saint John the Baptist Greek Orthodox Church
label: CO: Craig - St. John the Baptist
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἁγ. Βαπτιστοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Μνήμη Δικαίου μετʼ ἐγκωμίων, σοὶ δὲ ἀρκέσει ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ Κυρίου Πρόδρομε· ἀνεδείχθης γὰρ ὄντως καὶ Προφητῶν σεβασμιώτερος, ὅτι καὶ ἐν ῥείθροις βαπτίσαι κατηξιώθης τὸν κηρυττόμενον. Ὅθεν τῆς ἀληθείας ὑπεραθλήσας, χαίρων εὐηγγελίσω καὶ τοῖς ἐν ᾍδῃ, Θεὸν φανερωθέντα ἐν σαρκί, τὸν αἴροντα τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τοῦ κόσμου, καὶ παρέχοντα ἡμῖν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἁγίου, ἐνδόξου Προφήτου, Προδρόμου καὶ Βαπτιστοῦ Ἰωάννου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἁγίου, ἐνδόξου Προφήτου, Προδρόμου καὶ Βαπτιστοῦ Ἰωάννου
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For John the Baptist.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: The memory of the just is observed with hymns of praise; for you suffices the testimony of the Lord, O Forerunner. You have proved to be truly more ven’rable than the Prophets, since you were granted to baptize in the river the One whom they proclaimed. Therefore, when for the truth you had contested, rejoicing, to those in Hades you preached the Gospel, that God was manifested in the flesh, and takes away the sin of the world, and grants to us the great mercy.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy and glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist John,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy and glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist John.

Name: Assumption Cathedral
label: CO: Denver - Assumption
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῆς Κοιμήσεως.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει, τὴν παρθενίαν ἐφύλαξας. Ἐν τῇ Κοιμήσει, τὸν κόσμον οὐ κατέλιπες Θεοτόκε. Μετέστης πρὸς τὴν ζωήν, Μήτηρ ὑπάρχουσα τῆς ζωῆς, καὶ ταῖς πρεσβείαις ταῖς σαῖς λυτρουμένη, ἐκ θανάτου τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῆς Κοιμήσεως τῆς Θεοτόκου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῆς Κοιμήσεως τῆς Θεοτόκου,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For the Dormition.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: You gave birth yet preserved your virginity. You fell asleep in death yet did not desert the world, O Theotokos. You were transported to life, as you are Mother of Life and, by virtue of your intercessions, deliver our souls from death.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the Assumption of the Theotokos,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the Assumption of the Theotokos.

Name: Saint Nicholas Greek Orthodox Church
label: CO: Grand Jct - St. Nicholas
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἁγ. Νικολάου.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις Πατρὸς ἡμῶν Νικολάου, Ἀρχιεπισκόπου Μύρων τῆς Λυκίας, τοῦ θαυματουργοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Κανόνα πίστεως καὶ εἰκόνα πραότητος, ἐγκρατείας διδάσκαλον, ἀνέδειξέ σε τῇ ποίμνῃ σου, ἡ τῶν πραγμάτων ἀλήθεια· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκτήσω τῇ ταπεινώσει τὰ ὑψηλά, τῇ πτωχείᾳ τὰ πλούσια, Πάτερ ἱεράρχα Νικόλαε· πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, σωθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις πατρὸς ἡμῶν Νικολάου, ἀρχιεπισκόπου Μύρων τῆς Λυκίας, τοῦ θαυματουργοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις πατρὸς ἡμῶν Νικολάου, ἀρχιεπισκόπου Μύρων τῆς Λυκίας, τοῦ θαυματουργοῦ,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Nicholas.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of our Father among the Saints Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: A rule of faith are you, and an icon of gentleness, and a teacher of self-control. And to your flock this was evident, by the truth of your life and deeds. You were humble and therefore you acquired exalted gifts, treasure in heaven for being poor. O Father and Hierarch St. Nicholas, intercede with Christ our God, and entreat Him to save our souls.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: our Father among the Saints Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: our Father among the Saints Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia.

Name: Saint Catherine Greek Orthodox Church
label: CO: Greenwood Village - St. Catherine
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῆς Ἁγ. Αἰκατερίνης.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τῆς ἁγίας Μεγαλομάρτυρος καὶ πανσόφου Αἰκατερίνης,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Τὴν πανεύφημον νύμφην Χριστοῦ ὑμνήσωμεν, Αἰκατερῖναν τὴν θείαν καὶ πολιοῦχον Σινᾶ, τὴν βοήθειαν ἡμῶν καὶ ἀντίληψιν, ὅτι ἐφίμωσε λαμπρῶς, τοὺς κομψοὺς τῶν ἀσεβῶν, τοῦ Πνεύματος τῇ μαχαίρᾳ, καὶ νῦν ὡς Μάρτυς στεφθεῖσα, αἰτεῖται πᾶσι τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῆς ἁγίας Μεγαλομάρτυρος καὶ πανσόφου Αἰκατερίνης,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῆς ἁγίας Μεγαλομάρτυρος καὶ πανσόφου Αἰκατερίνης,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Catherine.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy Great-martyr and all-wise Catherine,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Let us praise and extol the all-lauded Bride of Christ,* the Protectress of Sinai, divine Saint Catherine,* as the one who gives aid and her assistance to us;* for she brilliantly suppressed the impious orators,* with the sword of the Spirit.* And being crowned as a martyr,* she asks that all receive the great mercy.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy Great-martyr and all-wise Catherine,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy Great-martyr and all-wise Catherine.

Name: Prophet Elias Chapel
label: CO: Hot Sulphur Springs - Prophet Elias
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Προφήτου Ἠλία.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐνδόξου Προφήτου Ἠλιοὺ τοῦ Θεσβίτου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐνδόξου Προφήτου Ἠλιοὺ τοῦ Θεσβίτου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Ὁ ἔνσαρκος Ἄγγελος, τῶν Προφητῶν ἡ κρηπίς, ὁ δεύτερος Πρόδρομος, τῆς παρουσίας Χριστοῦ, Ἠλίας ὁ ἔνδοξος, ἄνωθεν καταπέμψας, Ἐλισσαίῳ τὴν χάριν, νόσους ἀποδιώκει, καὶ λεπροὺς καθαρίζει· διὸ καὶ τοῖς τιμῶσιν αὐτὸν βρύει ἰάματα.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἁγίου ἐνδόξου Προφήτου Ἠλία,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἁγίου ἐνδόξου Προφήτου Ἠλία,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For Prophet Elias.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: of the holy and glorious Prophet Elias,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy and glorious Prophet Elias,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: The angel incarnate and the Prophets’ pedestal, * the second Forerunner of the coming of Christ, Elias the glorious, * sent down to Elisha the divine grace from heaven. * He drives away diseases and he cleanses lepers. * Therefore he pours out healings to those who honor him.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy and glorious Prophet Elias,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy and glorious Prophet Elias.

Name: Saint Spyridon Greek Orthodox Church
label: CO: Loveland - St. Spyridon
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἁγ. Σπυρίδωνος.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις Πατρὸς ἡμῶν Σπυρίδωνος, Ἐπισκόπου Τριμυθοῦντος, τοῦ Θαυματουργοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Τῆς Συνόδου τῆς πρώτης ἀνεδείχθης ὑπέρμαχος, καὶ θαυματουργὸς θεοφόρε, Σπυρίδων Πατὴρ ἡμῶν· διὸ νεκρᾷ σὺ ἐν τάφῳ προσφωνεῖς, καὶ ὄφιν εἰς χρυσοῦν μετέβαλες· καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλπειν τὰς ἁγίας σου εὐχάς, Ἀγγέλους ἔσχες συλλειτουργοῦντάς σοι Ἱερώτατε. Δόξα τῷ σὲ δοξάσαντι· δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι· δόξα τῷ ἐνεργοῦντι διὰ σοῦ πᾶσιν ἰάματα.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις πατρὸς ἡμῶν Σπυρίδωνος, ἐπισκόπου Τριμυθοῦντος, τοῦ θαυματουργοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις πατρὸς ἡμῶν Σπυρίδωνος, ἐπισκόπου Τριμυθοῦντος, τοῦ θαυματουργοῦ,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Spyridon.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of our Father among the Saints Spyridon the Wonderworker, Bishop of Trimythous,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: You were a champion of the First Ecumenical Council, * O Spyridon, our God-bearing Father and worker of miracles. * You addressed your daughter who was dead and entombed, * and you opportunely turned a snake into gold. * There were Angels celebrating along with you, * O sacred man, when you served the holy liturgy. * Glory to Christ who glorified you! * Glory to Him who put a crown on you! * Glory to Him who through you gives cures and healing to all!
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: our father among the saints Spyridon the wonderworker, bishop of Trimythous,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: our father among the saints Spyridon the wonderworker, bishop of Trimythous.

Name: Saints Constantine & Helen Greek Orthodox Church
label: ID: Boise - St. Con's
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἁγ. Κωνσταντίνου.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων, μεγάλων, θεοστέπτων καὶ Ἰσαποστόλων Βασιλέων, Κωνσταντίνου καὶ Ἑλένης,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων, μεγάλων, θεοστέπτων καὶ Ἰσαποστόλων Βασιλέων, Κωνσταντίνου καὶ Ἑλένης,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Τοῦ Σταυροῦ σου τὸν τύπον ἐν οὐρανῷ θεασάμενος, καὶ ὡς ὁ Παῦλος τὴν κλῆσιν οὐκ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων δεξάμενος, ὁ ἐν βασιλεῦσιν, Ἀπόστολός σου Κύριε, Βασιλεύουσαν πόλιν τῇ χειρί σου παρέθετο ἣν περίσῳζε διὰ παντὸς ἐν εἰρήνῃ, πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, μόνε Φιλάνθρωπε.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων, μεγάλων, θεοστέπτων καὶ Ἰσαποστόλων Βασιλέων, Κωνσταντίνου καὶ Ἑλένης,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων, μεγάλων, θεοστέπτων καὶ Ἰσαποστόλων Βασιλέων, Κωνσταντίνου καὶ Ἑλένης,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Constantine.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: of the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Your Apostle among the Rulers, St. Constantine, who once beheld in the sky the image of Your Cross, and who like Paul received his calling not from man, once entrusted the Ruling City into Your hand. We entreat You to restore it in peace forever, at the intercession of the Theotokos, O only benevolent Lord.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles.

client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Dionysios.

client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: To the offspring of Zakynthos and bishop of Aegina, * protector of Strophades Monastery, Saint Dionysios, * O believers, let us all with one accord * pay honor, and sincerely say to him: * “By your fervent prayers save us, who are observing your memory and who call to you: * Glory to Christ who glorified you; * glory to Him who made you marvelous; * glory to Him who gave us you to intercede for us.”

client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων, μεγάλων, θεοστέπτων καὶ Ἰσαποστόλων Βασιλέων, Κωνσταντίνου καὶ Ἑλένης,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Constantine.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: of the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Your Apostle among the Rulers, St. Constantine, who once beheld in the sky the image of Your Cross, and who like Paul received his calling not from man, once entrusted the Ruling City into Your hand. We entreat You to restore it in peace forever, at the intercession of the Theotokos, O only benevolent Lord.

client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles.

client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.

Therefore, when for the truth you had contested, rejoicing, to those in Hades you preached the Gospel, that God was manifested in the flesh, and takes away the sin of the world, and grants to us the great mercy.

client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Μέγαν εὕρατο ἐν τοῖς κινδύνοις, σὲ ὑπέρμαχον ἡ οἰκουμένη, Ἀθλοφόρε τὰ ἔθνη τροπούμενον. Ὡς οὖν Λυαίου καθεῖλες τὴν ἔπαρσιν, ἐν τῷ σταδίῳ θαῤῥύνας τὸν Νέστορα, οὕτως Ἅγιε, Μεγαλομάρτυς Δημήτριε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἡμῖν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ Ἁγίου ἐνδόξου Μεγαλομάρτυρος Δημητρίου τοῦ Μυροβλύτου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ Ἁγίου ἐνδόξου Μεγαλομάρτυρος Δημητρίου τοῦ Μυροβλύτου,

client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.

label: TX: Galveston - Assumption

client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει, τὴν παρθενίαν ἐφύλαξας. Ἐν τῇ Κοιμήσει, τὸν κόσμον οὐ κατέλιπες Θεοτόκε. Μετέστης πρὸς τὴν ζωήν, Μήτηρ ὑπάρχουσα τῆς ζωῆς, καὶ ταῖς πρεσβείαις ταῖς σαῖς λυτρουμένη, ἐκ θανάτου τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῆς Κοιμήσεως τῆς Θεοτόκου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῆς Κοιμήσεως τῆς Θεοτόκου,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For the Dormition.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: You gave birth yet preserved your virginity. You fell asleep in death yet did not desert the world, O Theotokos. You were transported to life, as you are Mother of Life and, by virtue of your intercessions, deliver our souls from death.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the Assumption of the Theotokos,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the Assumption of the Theotokos.

Name: Annunciation Cathedral
label: TX: Houston - Annunciation
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Εὐαγγελισμοῦ.

client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Σήμερον τῆς σωτηρίας ἡμῶν τὸ κεφάλαιον, καὶ τοῦ ἀπʼ αἰῶνος μυστηρίου ἡ φανέρωσις· ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ, Υἱὸς τῆς Παρθένου γίνεται, καὶ Γαβριὴλ τὴν χάριν εὐαγγελίζεται. Διὸ καὶ ἡμεῖς σὺν αὐτῷ τῇ Θεοτόκῳ βοήσωμεν· Χαῖρε Κεχαριτωμένη, ὁ Κύριος μετὰ σοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ Εὐαγγελισμοῦ τῆς Θεοτόκου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ Εὐαγγελισμοῦ τῆς Θεοτόκου,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For the Annunciation.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Today is the summary of our salvation, and the revelation of the age-old mystery. For the Son of God becomes the Son of the Virgin, and Gabriel announces the good news of grace. Therefore, let us join him, and cry aloud to the Theotokos: “Rejoice, Maiden full of grace! The Lord is with you.”
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the Annunciation of the Theotokos,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the Annunciation of the Theotokos.

client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ φθόγγος σου, ὡς δεξαμένην τὸν λόγον σου, διʼ οὗ θεοπρεπῶς ἐδογμάτισας, τὴν φύσιν τῶν ὄντων ἐτράνωσας, τὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἤθη κατεκόσμησας, Βασίλειον Ἱεράτευμα, Πάτερ Ὅσιε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἡμῖν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἐν Ἁγίοις Πατρὸς ἡμῶν Βασιλείου, Ἀρχιεπισκόπου Καισαρίας τῆς Καππαδοκίας τοῦ Μεγάλου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἐν Ἁγίοις Πατρὸς ἡμῶν Βασιλείου, Ἀρχιεπισκόπου Καισαρίας τῆς Καππαδοκίας τοῦ Μεγάλου,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Basil.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of our Father among the saints Basil the Great, Archbishop of Caesarea in Cappadocia,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Your proclamation went forth into all the earth, for it accepted your word, through which you taught the dogmas befitting God, you expounded on the nature of all that is, and you arranged the morals of society. A royal priesthood! Devout father Basil, intercede with Christ our God, to grant us His great mercy.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: our Father among the saints Basil the Great, Archbishop of Caesarea in Cappadocia,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: our Father among the saints Basil the Great, Archbishop of Caesarea in Cappadocia.

Name: Saint Andrew Greek Orthodox Church
label: TX: Lubbock - St. Andrew
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἁγ. Ἀνδρέου.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἐνδόξου Ἀποστόλου Ἀνδρέου τοῦ Πρωτοκλήτου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἐνδόξου Ἀποστόλου Ἀνδρέου τοῦ Πρωτοκλήτου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Ὡς τῶν Ἀποστόλων Πρωτόκλητος, καὶ τοῦ Κορυφαίου αὐτάδελφος, τὸν Δεσπότην τῶν ὅλων Ἀνδρέα ἱκέτευε, εἰρήνην τῇ οἰκουμένῃ δωρήσασθαι, καὶ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἐνδόξου Ἀποστόλου Ἀνδρέου τοῦ Πρωτοκλήτου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἐνδόξου Ἀποστόλου Ἀνδρέου τοῦ Πρωτοκλήτου,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Andrew.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: of the holy and glorious Apostle Andrew, the First-called,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy and glorious Apostle Andrew, the First-called,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: As first called of the Apostles and brother of Peter the Preeminent, O Andrew, intercede with the Master of all to grant peace to the whole world, and great mercy to our souls.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy and glorious Apostle Andrew, the First-called,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy and glorious Apostle Andrew, the First-called.

Name: Assumption Greek Orthodox Church
label: TX: San Angelo - Assumption
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῆς Κοιμήσεως.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Ἐν τῇ Γεννήσει, τὴν παρθενίαν ἐφύλαξας. Ἐν τῇ Κοιμήσει, τὸν κόσμον οὐ κατέλιπες Θεοτόκε. Μετέστης πρὸς τὴν ζωήν, Μήτηρ ὑπάρχουσα τῆς ζωῆς, καὶ ταῖς πρεσβείαις ταῖς σαῖς λυτρουμένη, ἐκ θανάτου τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῆς Κοιμήσεως τῆς Θεοτόκου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῆς Κοιμήσεως τῆς Θεοτόκου,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For the Dormition.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: You gave birth yet preserved your virginity. You fell asleep in death yet did not desert the world, O Theotokos. You were transported to life, as you are Mother of Life and, by virtue of your intercessions, deliver our souls from death.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the Assumption of the Theotokos,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the Assumption of the Theotokos.

Name: Saint Sophia Greek Orthodox Church
label: TX: San Antonio - Saint Sophia
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῆς Ἁγίας Σοφίας.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Εὐλογητὸς εἶ, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, ὁ πανσόφους τοὺς ἁλιεῖς ἀναδείξας, καταπέμψας αὐτοῖς τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, καὶ διʼ αὐτῶν τὴν οἰκουμένην σαγηνεύσας, Φιλάνθρωπε, δόξα σοι.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῆς ἁγίας Σοφίας τοῦ Θεοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῆς ἁγίας Σοφίας τοῦ Θεοῦ,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For Pentecost.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Blessed are You, O Christ our God. You sent down the Holy Spirit into the fishermen, and You gave them knowledge and wisdom in everything; and through them, as in a net You caught the whole world. O Lord who loves humanity, glory to You!
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy Wisdom of God,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy Wisdom of God.

Name: Saint Stephen Orthodox Mission
label: TX: Stephenville - St. Stephen
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἁγ. Στεφάνου.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: τοῦ ἁγίου Πρωτομάρτυρος, καὶ Ἀρχιδιακόνου Στεφάνου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τοῦ ἁγίου Πρωτομάρτυρος, καὶ Ἀρχιδιακόνου Στεφάνου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Βασίλειον διάδημα, ἐστέφθη σὴ κορυφή, ἐξ ἄθλων ὧν ὑπέμεινας, ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ, μαρτύρων Πρωτόαθλε· σὺ γὰρ τὴν Ἰουδαίων ἀπελέγξας μανίαν, εἶδές σου τὸν Σωτῆρα, τοῦ Πατρὸς δεξιόθεν. Αὐτὸν οὖν ἐκδυσώπει ἀεί, ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἁγίου πρωτομάρτυρος καὶ ἀρχιδιακόνου Στεφάνου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἁγίου πρωτομάρτυρος καὶ ἀρχιδιακόνου Στεφάνου,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Stephen.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: of the holy Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: O Stephen, a crown of royalty was laid on your head * for contests you courageously endured for Christ our God, * as first among Martyr saints. * You refuted the ravings of the Jews who accused you, * and you saw your Savior at the right hand of the Father. * We pray that you will ever entreat Him to save our souls.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen.

Name: Saint Nicholas Greek Orthodox Church
label: TX: Waco - St. Nicholas
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἁγ. Νικολάου.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις Πατρὸς ἡμῶν Νικολάου, Ἀρχιεπισκόπου Μύρων τῆς Λυκίας, τοῦ θαυματουργοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Κανόνα πίστεως καὶ εἰκόνα πραότητος, ἐγκρατείας διδάσκαλον, ἀνέδειξέ σε τῇ ποίμνῃ σου, ἡ τῶν πραγμάτων ἀλήθεια· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκτήσω τῇ ταπεινώσει τὰ ὑψηλά, τῇ πτωχείᾳ τὰ πλούσια, Πάτερ ἱεράρχα Νικόλαε· πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, σωθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις πατρὸς ἡμῶν Νικολάου, ἀρχιεπισκόπου Μύρων τῆς Λυκίας, τοῦ θαυματουργοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἐν ἁγίοις πατρὸς ἡμῶν Νικολάου, ἀρχιεπισκόπου Μύρων τῆς Λυκίας, τοῦ θαυματουργοῦ,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Nicholas.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of our Father among the Saints Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: A rule of faith are you, and an icon of gentleness, and a teacher of self-control. And to your flock this was evident, by the truth of your life and deeds. You were humble and therefore you acquired exalted gifts, treasure in heaven for being poor. O Father and Hierarch St. Nicholas, intercede with Christ our God, and entreat Him to save our souls.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: our Father among the Saints Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: our Father among the Saints Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia.

Name: St. John the Theologian Greek Orthodox Church
label: TX: Webster - St. John Theologian
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἁγ. Ἰωάννου.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: τοῦ ἁγίου, ἐνδόξου καὶ πανευφήμου Ἀποστόλου καὶ Θεολόγου, Ἰωάννου τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τοῦ ἁγίου, ἐνδόξου καὶ πανευφήμου Ἀποστόλου καὶ Θεολόγου, Ἰωάννου τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Ἀπόστολε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ ἠγαπημένε, ἐπιτάχυνον, ῥῦσαι λαὸν ἀναπολόγητον· δέχεταί σε προσπίπτοντα, ὁ ἐπιπεσόντα τῷ στήθει καταδεξάμενος, ὃν ἱκέτευε, Θεολόγε, καὶ ἐπίμονον νέφος ἐθνῶν διασκεδάσαι, αἰτούμενος ἡμῖν εἰρήνην, καὶ τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ Ἁγίου, ἐνδόξου καὶ πανευφήμου Ἀποστόλου καὶ Θεολόγου, Ἰωάννου τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ Ἁγίου, ἐνδόξου καὶ πανευφήμου Ἀποστόλου καὶ Θεολόγου, Ἰωάννου τοῦ Εὐαγγελιστοῦ,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. John.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: of the holy, glorious and all-lauded Apostle and Theologian, John the Evangelist,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy, glorious and all-lauded Apostle and Theologian, John the Evangelist,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: O Apostle, the beloved of Christ God, hasten to deliver us, a people that has no excuse. He accepts you supplicating Him, for He condescended at the Supper to let you lean on Him. Entreat Him, O Theologian, that He scatter the persistent cloud of hostile nations, and pray for us, for peace and great mercy.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy, glorious and all-lauded Apostle and Theologian, John the Evangelist,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy, glorious and all-lauded Apostle and Theologian, John the Evangelist.

Name: Holy Cross Greek Orthodox Church
label: TX: Wichita Falls - Holy Cross
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Σταυροῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Σῶσον, Κύριε, τὸν λαόν σου, καὶ εὐλόγησον τὴν κληρονομίαν σου, νίκας τοῖς βασιλεῦσι κατὰ βαρβάρων δωρούμενος, καὶ τὸ σὸν φυλάττων, διὰ τοῦ Σταυροῦ σου πολίτευμα.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ τιμίου Σταυροῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ τιμίου Σταυροῦ,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For the Cross.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Save, O Lord, Your people and bless Your inheritance, granting victory to the faithful over the enemy, and by Your Cross protecting Your commonwealth.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the Holy Cross,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the Holy Cross.

Name: Transfiguration Greek Orthodox Church
label: UT: Ogden - Transfiguration
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῆς Μεταμορφώσεως.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Μετεμορφώθης ἐν τῷ ὄρει Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός, δείξας τοῖς Μαθηταῖς σου τὴν δόξαν σου, καθὼς ἠδύναντο. Λάμψον καὶ ἡμῖν τοῖς ἁμαρτωλοῖς, τὸ φῶς σου τὸ ἀΐδιον, πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, φωτοδότα δόξα σοι.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῆς Μεταμορφώσεως τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῆς Μεταμορφώσεως τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For the Transfiguration.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: You were transfigured upon the mountain, O Christ our God, showing to Your disciples Your glory as much as they could bear. Do also in us, sinners though we may be, shine Your everlasting light, by the intercessions of the Theotokos, O Giver of light. Glory to You.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the Transfiguration of our Savior Jesus Christ,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the Transfiguration of our Savior Jesus Christ.

client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῆς Κοιμήσεως τῆς Θεοτόκου,

client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the Assumption of the Theotokos,

Name: Holy Trinity Cathedral
label: UT: Salt Lake City - Holy Trinity
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Εὐλογητὸς εἶ, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, ὁ πανσόφους τοὺς ἁλιεῖς ἀναδείξας, καταπέμψας αὐτοῖς τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, καὶ διʼ αὐτῶν τὴν οἰκουμένην σαγηνεύσας, Φιλάνθρωπε, δόξα σοι.

client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῆς Ἁγίας Τριάδος,

client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Blessed are You, O Christ our God. You sent down the Holy Spirit into the fishermen, and You gave them knowledge and wisdom in everything; and through them, as in a net You caught the whole world. O Lord who loves humanity, glory to You!
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the Holy Trinity,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the Holy Trinity.

Name: Prophet Elias Greek Orthodox Church
label: UT: Holladay - Prophet Elias
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Προφήτου Ἠλία.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐνδόξου Προφήτου Ἠλιοὺ τοῦ Θεσβίτου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τοῦ Ἁγίου Ἐνδόξου Προφήτου Ἠλιοὺ τοῦ Θεσβίτου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Ὁ ἔνσαρκος Ἄγγελος, τῶν Προφητῶν ἡ κρηπίς, ὁ δεύτερος Πρόδρομος, τῆς παρουσίας Χριστοῦ, Ἠλίας ὁ ἔνδοξος, ἄνωθεν καταπέμψας, Ἐλισσαίῳ τὴν χάριν, νόσους ἀποδιώκει, καὶ λεπροὺς καθαρίζει· διὸ καὶ τοῖς τιμῶσιν αὐτὸν βρύει ἰάματα.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τοῦ ἁγίου ἐνδόξου Προφήτου Ἠλία,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τοῦ ἁγίου ἐνδόξου Προφήτου Ἠλία,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For Prophet Elias.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: of the holy and glorious Prophet Elias,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy and glorious Prophet Elias,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: The angel incarnate and the Prophets’ pedestal, * the second Forerunner of the coming of Christ, Elias the glorious, * sent down to Elisha the divine grace from heaven. * He drives away diseases and he cleanses lepers. * Therefore he pours out healings to those who honor him.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy and glorious Prophet Elias,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy and glorious Prophet Elias.

Name: Saint Anna Greek Orthodox Church
label: UT: Sandy - St. Anna
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῆς Ἁγίας Ἄννης.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Ζωὴν τὴν κυήσασαν, ἐκυοφόρησας, ἁγνὴν Θεομήτορα, θεόφρον Ἄννα· διὸ πρὸς λῆξιν οὐράνιον, ἔνθα εὐφραινομένων, κατοικία ἐν δόξῃ, χαίρουσα νῦν μετέστης, τοῖς τιμῶσί σε πόθῳ, πταισμάτων αἰτουμένη, ἱλασμὸν ἀειμακάριστε.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῆς Ἁγίας Ἄννης, Μητρὸς τῆς Ὑπεραγίας Θεοτόκου,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῆς Ἁγίας Ἄννης, Μητρὸς τῆς Ὑπεραγίας Θεοτόκου,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Anna.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: O God-minded Anna, you bore the pure Mother of God, the one who within her conceived the Conceiver of life itself.You were therefore transported to a place now in heaven.Joyful ones all reside there in the home of all gladness, asking for forgiveness for those who honor you, O blessed one.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: St. Anna, the Mother of the all-holy Theotokos,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: St. Anna, the Mother of the all-holy Theotokos.

Name: Holy Trinity Greek Orthodox Church
label: WY: Casper - Holy Trinity
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Εὐλογητὸς εἶ, Χριστὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν, ὁ πανσόφους τοὺς ἁλιεῖς ἀναδείξας, καταπέμψας αὐτοῖς τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, καὶ διʼ αὐτῶν τὴν οἰκουμένην σαγηνεύσας, Φιλάνθρωπε, δόξα σοι.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῆς Ἁγίας Τριάδος,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῆς Ἁγίας Τριάδος,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For Pentecost.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Blessed are You, O Christ our God. You sent down the Holy Spirit into the fishermen, and You gave them knowledge and wisdom in everything; and through them, as in a net You caught the whole world. O Lord who loves humanity, glory to You!
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the Holy Trinity,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the Holy Trinity.

Name: Holy Apostles Greek Orthodox Church
label: WY: Cheyenne - Holy Apostles
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τῶν Ἁγίων Ἀποστόλων.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Ἀπόστολοι Ἅγιοι, πρεσβεύσατε τῷ ἐλεήμονι Θεῷ, ἵνα πταισμάτων ἄφεσιν, παράσχῃ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων καὶ πανευφήμων Ἀποστόλων,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων καὶ πανευφήμων Ἀποστόλων,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For the Holy Apostles.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: O holy Apostles, make intercession to our merciful God, that He grant our souls forgiveness of offenses.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy, glorious, and all-laudable Apostles,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy, glorious, and all-laudable Apostles.

Name: Saints Constantine & Helen Greek Orthodox Church
label: WY: Cheyenne - St. Con's
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: Τοῦ Ἁγ. Κωνσταντίνου.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων, μεγάλων, θεοστέπτων καὶ Ἰσαποστόλων Βασιλέων, Κωνσταντίνου καὶ Ἑλένης,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων, μεγάλων, θεοστέπτων καὶ Ἰσαποστόλων Βασιλέων, Κωνσταντίνου καὶ Ἑλένης,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: Τοῦ Ναοῦ.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Τοῦ Σταυροῦ σου τὸν τύπον ἐν οὐρανῷ θεασάμενος, καὶ ὡς ὁ Παῦλος τὴν κλῆσιν οὐκ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων δεξάμενος, ὁ ἐν βασιλεῦσιν, Ἀπόστολός σου Κύριε, Βασιλεύουσαν πόλιν τῇ χειρί σου παρέθετο ἣν περίσῳζε διὰ παντὸς ἐν εἰρήνῃ, πρεσβείαις τῆς Θεοτόκου, μόνε Φιλάνθρωπε.
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων, μεγάλων, θεοστέπτων καὶ Ἰσαποστόλων Βασιλέων, Κωνσταντίνου καὶ Ἑλένης,
client_gr_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: τῶν Ἁγίων ἐνδόξων, μεγάλων, θεοστέπτων καὶ Ἰσαποστόλων Βασιλέων, Κωνσταντίνου καὶ Ἑλένης,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localchurch.title: For St. Constantine.
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.su: of the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles,
client_en_US_goa|cl.localpatronsaint1.di: of the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles,
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.title: For the Parish Church.
client_en_US_goa|cl.Apolytikion1.text: Your Apostle among the Rulers, St. Constantine, who once beheld in the sky the image of Your Cross, and who like Paul received his calling not from man, once entrusted the Ruling City into Your hand. We entreat You to restore it in peace forever, at the intercession of the Theotokos, O only benevolent Lord.
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.name: the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles,
client_en_US_goa|cl.consecration.prayer1: the holy, glorious, great, God-crowned Sovereigns Constantine and Helen, the Equals to the Apostles.
